reviews.title: Better and WAY cheaper than the originals.
reviews.comment: I use the actual $130 Senheisser G3 mics and wireless systems every day for work. I bought these for my freelance video/audio set up at home and they have almost the exact pickup pattern and are actually a little more sensitive/louder than the originals. They don't have a removable pop filter like the originals but they are very small so it hasent been a problem. Easy to hide under garmets, has a fantastic sound, and a fantastic price. Only thing is the cord seems thinner and cheaper and is about 1.5 feet shorter than the originals, but that hasent been a problem. Still plenty long to run for the transmitter to collar with length to spare. I'll be buying more!
reviews.author: Tyler R.

reviews.title: Best for the money!
reviews.comment: I read the reviews and also went to YouTube to learn more about this microphone. It was highly recommended and in a side-by-side test, I couldn't believe my ears. It outperformed the Sennheiser and other microphones up to nearly $150 among a grouping of five to seven other microphones. Wow.. I put it in my cart and held onto it for nearly 6 months until I had the funds to invest in new gear. I tested it shortly after it arrived, recording into a audio app on my Note 8 and it didn't disappoint! The sound is so clear and crisp! Perfect for my semi pro needs. One of the LAST true values out there for the money. May not outperform a $300 lapel mic or purpose built professional system but it will hold it's own against anything else.
reviews.author: John Crooks

reviews.title: Very good for the money
reviews.comment:
I bought this unit as a back up for the lavalier that came with my Sennheiser ew100 g3 when I fond out the replacement is $150 dollars.  With that said this mic works very well.
The same quality is not the same as the original but with a small adjustment in the sensitivity of the body pack it pick up my voice from the same distance with no problem.  It is extremely small and neat which is a plus.  The clip that holds it is a little flimsy but manageable.  Only one real problem for me.  There is a noticeable increase in the echo if you are recording but with an adjustment to the reverb it's okay, not great but okay.  Maybe someone better skilled with a mixer can get it just right.
Overall if you need a inexpensive lavalier microphone this is a good choice.  I use mine for preaching at a small church that records the sermons and it's working for us.
reviews.author: Book User

reviews.title: Good quality, very lightweight
reviews.comment:
It sounds great. I use it with a Tascam DR-05. The wind screen for the mic is very cheap and falls off though, but maybe you could tape it on or something. I've used this in a wedding to record the minister and the 2 weds all in one mic since they were all close together. They were happy with the result! They all came through very clear. No buzz or hissing on my budget setup.
The cord is nice and long! It's easy to wrap it with a twist tie whenever it's too long. The mic seems to pick up a good range of sound frequency; although I haven't tested this specifically, I've heard it pick up stuff around 50-60hz.
I also use it inside my full face motorcycle helmet for MotoVlogging and it works great for that too. Just stick this mic inside your cheekpad so the wind doesn't hit it, and connect it to your recording device. I mounted my DR-05 recorder to my helmet so the wire can just stick out from the helmet straight into there.
